newsitem.title: USA: AlliedSignal, Aerospace Safety settle suit.
newsitem.headline: AlliedSignal, Aerospace Safety settle suit.

text.p: AlliedSignal Inc and Aerospace Safety Technologies Inc said Wednesday they have reached a settlement in a patent infringement lawsuit.
Aerospace Safety, a subsidiary of Thermion Systems International, filed the lawsuit accusing AlliedSignal of improperly using its proprietary and patented electrothermal heating technology.
That technology is used to eliminate ice from aircraft surfaces.
The bulk of the agreement, which was described as "amicable," has been deemed confidential.
However, the company said that AlliedSignal has received a license to use its technology for selected systems for commercial aircraft and for space-related applications.
Aerospace Safety has received a license to use certain proprietary and patented AlliedSignal technologies for aerospace and commercial applications, it added.
The companies also have agreed to seek opportunities to collaborate in the development of new products.
